subject: general
question: Bilateral symmetry, segmentation, coelom and open circulatory system are the characteristics of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__A__****__rthropoda__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Arthropoda:**

__
 
• It is the **largest phylum** of Animalia which **includes insects.**
 
• Over **two-thirds of all named species** on earth are arthropods.
 
• They are** bilaterally symmetrical, triploblastic, segmented and coelomate** animals.
 
• The body consists of **head, thorax and abdomen.** They have** jointed appendages** (arthros-joint, poda-appendages).
 
• Their circulatory system is of **open type.**
 
• Their **fertilization** is usually **internal.** They are mostly **oviparous**.
 
• **Examples:** Economically important insects Apis (honey bee), Bombyx (silkworm), Laccifer (lac insect).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Chordata:**

 
• Animals belonging to phylum Chordata are fundamentally characterized by the **presence of a notochord, a dorsal hollow nerve cord and paired pharyngeal gill slits.**
 
• These are **bilaterally symmetrical, triploblastic, coelomate with organ-system level** of organization.

**Porifera: **

 
• Commonly known as** sponges.**
 
• They are generally **marine and mostly asymmetrical animals.**
 
• These are **primitive multicellular animals.**
 
• **Examples:** Sycon (Scypha), Spongilla (Fresh water sponge) and Euspongia (Bath sponge).

**Protozoa:**

 
• All protozoans are **heterotrophs and live as predators or parasites.**
 
• There are four major groups:
 
 
• Amoeboid
 
• Flagellated
 
• Ciliated
 
• Sporozoans
